verdict.rationale: Sentry's Seer/Autofix feature explicitly automates root cause analysis on incoming issues ('Automatically scan issues as they come into Sentry, finding root causes, and automating triage', 'Automatically root-cause any issue') and can even generate PRs to fix them, directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of Autofix's root-cause accuracy and no community corroboration of real-world reliability.
